title: The Crown of the Ninefold Court
author: Mara Brightwater
blurb: Jonah Galloway, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
